OE1.name: Flexibilidad energetica
OE1.statement: Aumentar la capacidad de desplazar cargas y aprovechar almacenamiento, EVs y autoconsumo en comunidades de edificios interactivos con la red electrica.

trace.name: grid_import
trace.note: CityLearn v2 district import ratio to baseline.

trace.name: zero_net_energy
trace.note: CityLearn v2 district net exchange ratio to baseline.

trace.name: pv_self_consumption_ratio
trace.note: CityLearn v2 PV self-consumption ratio for autoconsumption.

trace.name: battery_throughput_total
trace.note: CityLearn v2 district battery throughput in kWh.

trace.name: ev_v2g_export_total
trace.note: CityLearn v2 EV vehicle-to-grid export in kWh.

OE2.name: Emisiones de CO2
OE2.statement: Reducir la huella ambiental del distrito, minimizando importaciones en horas de alta intensidad de carbono.

trace.name: carbon_emissions
trace.note: CityLearn v2 district CO2 ratio to baseline.

trace.name: carbon_emissions_control
trace.note: Total district greenhouse gas emissions under control in kgCO2.

trace.name: carbon_emissions_baseline
trace.note: Total district greenhouse gas emissions for the CityLearn v2 baseline in kgCO2.

trace.name: carbon_emissions_delta
trace.note: Control minus baseline total district greenhouse gas emissions in kgCO2.

OE3.name: Costos energeticos
OE3.statement: Optimizar el gasto energetico, reduciendo picos de demanda y aprovechando tarifas dinamicas.

trace.name: electricity_cost
trace.note: CityLearn v2 normalized district cost ratio to baseline.

trace.name: electricity_cost_control
trace.note: Total district electricity cost under control in EUR.

trace.name: electricity_cost_baseline
trace.note: Total district electricity cost for the CityLearn v2 baseline in EUR.

trace.name: electricity_cost_delta
trace.note: Control minus baseline total district electricity cost in EUR.

trace.name: price_signal_deviation
trace.note: Not a native evaluate_v2 KPI in this codebase; derived from district net import and the electricity_pricing signal.
